answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 16 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 501 identities costs 501 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the lotus here is verification, the pearl of cost is what stops the farm, and the glacier of the record keeps every claim checkable.
